novelty.justification: The novelty route is primarily a new measurement combination: the claim proposes a "relation-conditioned linear probe that decodes the target object from the subject token's residual stream at every layer" and predicts that "peak-then-decay" trajectories expose "known but unsaid" factual retrieval. Searches for "subject token residual stream decode object factual recall layer linear probe," "layer-wise factual answer correctness tuned lens," and "known but unsaid internal knowledge wrong answer trajectory" found close components in Geva et al.'s Dissecting Recall of Factual Associations in Auto-Regressive Language Models, Hernandez et al.'s Linearity of Relation Decoding in Transformer Language Models, Belrose et al.'s Tuned Lens, No Answer Needed (2025), and On the Effect of Uncertainty on Layer-wise Inference Dynamics (2025): these respectively cover subject-centered factual information flow, relation-specific linear subject-to-object mappings, layerwise prediction trajectories, and activation-based correctness prediction. Turning those components into an entity-specific subject-position trajectory whose rise and decay predict expression failure is a substantive but natural multi-step extension rather than a new core interpretability paradigm, supporting standard rather than high novelty.
